chapterInfo.content:
21
Yesu yi ne ho adi kyerɛ Asuafoɔ baason
1Yeinom akyiri no, Yesu yii ne ho kyerɛɛ n’asuafoɔ no bio Tiberia po ho. Na sɛdeɛ ɔyii ne ho kyerɛeɛ nie: 2#Yoh 1.46 Na Simon Petro ne Toma a wɔfrɛ no Ata ne Natanael a ɔfiri Kana a ɛwɔ Galilea ne Sebedeo mma ne n’asuafoɔ no mu baanu nso wɔ hɔ. 3Simon Petro see wɔn sɛ: Merekɔ po. Wɔsee no sɛ: Yɛn nso, yɛne wo bɛkɔ. Wɔfirii adi kɔɔ kodoɔ mu, na anadwo no, wɔannyi hwee. 4#Yoh 20.14; Luka 24.16 Na adeɛ reyɛ akye no, Yesu bɛgyinaa mpoano, nanso na asuafoɔ no nnim sɛ ɛyɛ Yesu. 5#Luka 24.41 Ɛnna Yesu bisaa wɔn sɛ: Yaanom, moanya nam anaa? Wɔbuaa no sɛ: Dabi. 6#Luka 5.4-7 Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Momfa asau no ngu kodoɔ no nifa, na mobɛnya bi. Ɛnna wɔguiɛ, na mpataa no dodoɔ nti, na wɔntumi ntwe asau no bio. 7#Yoh 13.23 Ɛnna osuani a Yesu dɔ no no see Petro sɛ: Ɛyɛ Awurade a! Ɛnna Simon Petro tee sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade no, ɔde n’atadeɛ kyekyeree ne ho soɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔda adagya, na ɔtoo ne ho hwee ɛpo no mu. 8Na asuafoɔ a aka no nam kodoɔ kumaa no mu bae, na wɔne asase so nware, na ɛbɛyɛ basafa ɔha, na wɔtwee asau no ne mpataa no.
9Na wɔsii fam no, wɔhunuu nnyansramma a ɛnam gu soɔ ne paanoo. 10Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Momfa nam a moyii no seesei no bi mmra! 11Simon Petro kɔe, na ɔkɔtwee asau no baa asase so; na mpataa akɛseɛ ɔha aduonum mmiɛnsa ayɛ no ma; wɔdɔɔso saa deɛ, nanso asau no antete. 12Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Mommra mmɛka mo ano. Nso asuafoɔ no mu biara antumi ammisa no sɛ: Woyɛ hwan? Na wɔnim sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade. 13#Yoh 6.11 Ɛnna Yesu bɛfaa paanoo no de maa wɔn, ɛne apataa no saa ara. 14Yei ne ne mprɛnsa so a Yesu nyane firii awufoɔ mu no, ɔyii ne ho kyerɛɛ asuafoɔ no.
Yesu sɔ Petro dɔ hwɛ
15 # Yoh 1.43 Ɛnna wɔdidi wieeɛ no, Yesu see Simon Petro sɛ: Simon, Yohane ba, wodɔ me sene yeinom? Ɔsee no sɛ: Aane, Awurade, wonim sɛ medɔ wo. Yesu see no sɛ: Yɛne me nnwammaa! 16#1 Pe 5.2; 5.4 Yesu see no ne mprenu so sɛ: Simon, Yohane ba, wodɔ me? Ɔsee no sɛ: Aane, Awurade, wonim sɛ medɔ wo. Yesu see no sɛ: Hwɛ me nnwan! 17#Yoh 13.38; 16.30 Ɔsee no ne mprɛnsa so sɛ: Simon, Yohane ba, wodɔ me? Ɛyɛɛ Petro awerɛho sɛ wabisa no mprɛnsa sɛ: Wodɔ me? Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: Awurade, wonim ade nyinaa, wonim sɛ medɔ wo. Yesu see no sɛ: Yɛne me nnwan! 18Mereka akyerɛ wo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ, woyɛ aberanteɛ no, wobɔɔ abɔsoɔ, na wokɔɔ faako a wopɛ; na wonya bɔ akora a, wobɛtene wo nsa, na obi abɔ wo abɔsoɔ, na ɔde wo akɔ faako a wompɛ. 19#Yoh 13.36 (Ɔkaa yei de kyerɛɛ owu ko a ɔde bɛhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam.) Na ɔkaa yei no, ɔsee no sɛ: Di m’akyi!
Yesu ne Osuani a ɔdɔ no no
20 # Yoh 13.23 Ɛnna Petro danee n’ani no, ɔhunuu osuani a Yesu dɔ no no sɛ ɔdi wɔn akyire, ɔno na ɔtweree ne kokom adidie no ase a ɔkaa sɛ: Awurade, hwan ne deɛ ɔbɛyi wo ama no? 21Ɔno na Petro hunuu no no, ɔsee Yesu sɛ: Awurade, na oyi ɛ? 22Yesu see no sɛ: Sɛ mepɛ sɛ ɔtena hɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛba a, ɛfa wo ho bɛn? Wo deɛ, di m’akyi! 23Ɛnna asɛm yi trɛɛ anuanom no mu sɛ saa osuani no renwu; nanso Yesu anka ankyerɛ no sɛ ɔrenwu, na ɔse: Mepɛ sɛ ɔtena hɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛba a, ɛfa wo ho bɛn?
24 # Yoh 15.27 Oyi ne osuani a ɔdi yeinom ho adanseɛ na ɔtwerɛɛ yeinom no; na yɛnim sɛ n’adanseɛ no yɛ nokorɛ.
Awieeɛ
25 # Yoh 20.30 Na nnoɔma pii wɔ hɔ nso a Yesu yɛeɛ, ɛno na sɛ wɔtwerɛɛ ne nyinaa mmaako mmaako a, anka mesusu sɛ, nwoma a wɔbɛtwerɛ no rensene wiase mpo.

Na sɛdeɛ ɔyii ne ho kyerɛeɛ nie: Na Simon Petro ne Toma a wɔfrɛ no Ata ne Natanael a ɔfiri Kana a ɛwɔ Galilea ne Sebedeo mma ne n’asuafoɔ no mu baanu nso wɔ hɔ. Simon Petro see wɔn sɛ: Merekɔ po. Wɔsee no sɛ: Yɛn nso, yɛne wo bɛkɔ. Wɔfirii adi kɔɔ kodoɔ mu, na anadwo no, wɔannyi hwee. Na adeɛ reyɛ akye no, Yesu bɛgyinaa mpoano, nanso na asuafoɔ no nnim sɛ ɛyɛ Yesu. Ɛnna Yesu bisaa wɔn sɛ: Yaanom, moanya nam anaa? Wɔbuaa no sɛ: Dabi. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Momfa asau no ngu kodoɔ no nifa, na mobɛnya bi. Ɛnna wɔguiɛ, na mpataa no dodoɔ nti, na wɔntumi ntwe asau no bio. Ɛnna osuani a Yesu dɔ no no see Petro sɛ: Ɛyɛ Awurade a! Ɛnna Simon Petro tee sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade no, ɔde n’atadeɛ kyekyeree ne ho soɔ, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔda adagya, na ɔtoo ne ho hwee ɛpo no mu. Na asuafoɔ a aka no nam kodoɔ kumaa no mu bae, na wɔne asase so nware, na ɛbɛyɛ basafa ɔha, na wɔtwee asau no ne mpataa no.
Na wɔsii fam no, wɔhunuu nnyansramma a ɛnam gu soɔ ne paanoo. Na Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Momfa nam a moyii no seesei no bi mmra! Simon Petro kɔe, na ɔkɔtwee asau no baa asase so; na mpataa akɛseɛ ɔha aduonum mmiɛnsa ayɛ no ma; wɔdɔɔso saa deɛ, nanso asau no antete. Yesu see wɔn sɛ: Mommra mmɛka mo ano. Nso asuafoɔ no mu biara antumi ammisa no sɛ: Woyɛ hwan? Na wɔnim sɛ ɛyɛ Awurade. Ɛnna Yesu bɛfaa paanoo no de maa wɔn, ɛne apataa no saa ara. Yei ne ne mprɛnsa so a Yesu nyane firii awufoɔ mu no, ɔyii ne ho kyerɛɛ asuafoɔ no.

Ɛnna wɔdidi wieeɛ no, Yesu see Simon Petro sɛ: Simon, Yohane ba, wodɔ me sene yeinom? Ɔsee no sɛ: Aane, Awurade, wonim sɛ medɔ wo. Yesu see no sɛ: Yɛne me nnwammaa! Yesu see no ne mprenu so sɛ: Simon, Yohane ba, wodɔ me? Ɔsee no sɛ: Aane, Awurade, wonim sɛ medɔ wo. Yesu see no sɛ: Hwɛ me nnwan! Ɔsee no ne mprɛnsa so sɛ: Simon, Yohane ba, wodɔ me? Ɛyɛɛ Petro awerɛho sɛ wabisa no mprɛnsa sɛ: Wodɔ me? Na ɔbuaa no sɛ: Awurade, wonim ade nyinaa, wonim sɛ medɔ wo. Yesu see no sɛ: Yɛne me nnwan! Mereka akyerɛ wo nokorɛ mu pa ara sɛ, woyɛ aberanteɛ no, wobɔɔ abɔsoɔ, na wokɔɔ faako a wopɛ; na wonya bɔ akora a, wobɛtene wo nsa, na obi abɔ wo abɔsoɔ, na ɔde wo akɔ faako a wompɛ. (Ɔkaa yei de kyerɛɛ owu ko a ɔde bɛhyɛ Onyankopɔn animuonyam.) Na ɔkaa yei no, ɔsee no sɛ: Di m’akyi!

Ɛnna Petro danee n’ani no, ɔhunuu osuani a Yesu dɔ no no sɛ ɔdi wɔn akyire, ɔno na ɔtweree ne kokom adidie no ase a ɔkaa sɛ: Awurade, hwan ne deɛ ɔbɛyi wo ama no? Ɔno na Petro hunuu no no, ɔsee Yesu sɛ: Awurade, na oyi ɛ? Yesu see no sɛ: Sɛ mepɛ sɛ ɔtena hɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛba a, ɛfa wo ho bɛn? Wo deɛ, di m’akyi! Ɛnna asɛm yi trɛɛ anuanom no mu sɛ saa osuani no renwu; nanso Yesu anka ankyerɛ no sɛ ɔrenwu, na ɔse: Mepɛ sɛ ɔtena hɔ kɔsi sɛ mɛba a, ɛfa wo ho bɛn?
Oyi ne osuani a ɔdi yeinom ho adanseɛ na ɔtwerɛɛ yeinom no; na yɛnim sɛ n’adanseɛ no yɛ nokorɛ.

Na nnoɔma pii wɔ hɔ nso a Yesu yɛeɛ, ɛno na sɛ wɔtwerɛɛ ne nyinaa mmaako mmaako a, anka mesusu sɛ, nwoma a wɔbɛtwerɛ no rensene wiase mpo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
